name: Visa Assistant — Phase 2 Additions
_description: Add these nodes to the existing Phase 1 n8n workflow. Connect 'Form & Portal Lookup' after 'Build Final Report', then connect 'Tracker Init' after 'Save Report to Database'. The Appointment sub-workflow is triggered manually from the chat.

nodes.name: Appointment Formatter
nodes._usage: Connect after user provides appointment details in chat. Pass output to 'Send a message' node.

workflow_connection_instructions.step_1: In the existing workflow, find 'Build Final Report' node
workflow_connection_instructions.step_2: Add 'Form & Portal Lookup' node and connect: Build Final Report → Form & Portal Lookup → Save Report to Database1
workflow_connection_instructions.step_3: Add 'Tracker Init' node and connect: Save Report to Database1 → Tracker Init → Return Report to Chat
workflow_connection_instructions.step_4: The 'Appointment Formatter' node is a standalone sub-workflow. Trigger it from the main chat when user provides appointment details.
workflow_connection_instructions.step_5: Optionally connect a 'Google Calendar' node after 'Appointment Formatter' to auto-create calendar events if the user has granted OAuth
